page.notes: The initial D of "DIctæ" is a large woodcut-style initial, joined to the first word. "Itaq;" stands alone on its own line, set in italic with an ornament after it, and is given as its own paragraph. The line-break hyphen in "pra-cticum" and "pri-mum" is joined.
